title: previewBinding
responsibility: Validates a visual unit preview against its declared screenshot state and viewport.

inputs.name: previewBinding.unit
inputs.description: The visual unit to check: its `id`, the scenario ids it belongs to in `scenarios`, and an optional `preview` selecting the `scenario`, `state` and `viewport` to validate. When `preview` is absent the result is an empty list, so the unit is checked only when a preview is declared.

inputs.name: previewBinding.scenarios
inputs.description: The scenario manifests searched for the id named by `unit.preview.scenario`; the first manifest with that id is used, and only its `id`, `units`, `states`, `evidence` and `viewports` are read. The array is not searched when `unit.preview` is absent, and an id that no manifest has produces an `unknown preview scenario` message.

outputs.name: issues
outputs.description: Validation messages for the unit's `preview`: an empty list when `preview` is absent, or when its scenario exists, its state shows the unit with `coverage` set to `required`, and a required screenshot covers that state at the selected viewport, which the scenario declares; otherwise a single message that begins with the unit id. Only the first failed check is reported, so the list never holds more than one message.
examples: reports.component.evidence-grid: preview state populated has no required screenshot at mobile

outputs.name: previewBinding
outputs.description: The array returned by `previewBinding`, the same value as the `issues` output: empty when `preview` is absent or every check passes, otherwise a single message that begins with the unit id and describes the first failed check.
examples: reports.component.evidence-grid: preview state populated has no required screenshot at mobile
